d: Mexico ke Baja Desert se lekar Turkey ke mountains, Ireland ke rugged coast aur Belize ke dense rainforest tak, Bear Grylls ke saamne har baar ek nayi wilderness hai! Louisiana ke swamps, Romania ke Carpathian Mountains, South Dakota ke vast landscapes aur Canada's frozen Yukon territory mein uska survival adventure shuru hota hai. Har location ka terrain alag, har challenge ki shuruaat alag. Dekhiye kaise Bear apne surroundings ko samajhta hai aur anjaan wilderness mein survival ka raasta dhoondhne nikal padta hai!
